dcterms:description: A large-scale dataset of pairs of stylized face (SF) and ground truth real face (RF) images synthesized from the CelebA dataset, used for training the Identity-preserving Face Recovery from Portraits (IFRP) method.
dcterms:title: Synthesized Dataset of Stylized and Real Faces
